def fill(sel, text):
    js(f"""(()=>{{const e=document.querySelector('{sel}');e.scrollIntoView({{block:'center'}});e.focus();e.select&&e.select();}})()""")
    box = js(f"""(()=>{{const r=document.querySelector('{sel}').getBoundingClientRect();return [r.x+r.width/2,r.y+r.height/2]}})()""")
    click_at_xy(*box)
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='rawKeyDown', key='a', code='KeyA', commands=['selectAll'])
    cdp('Input.dispatchKeyEvent', type='keyUp', key='a', code='KeyA')
    type_text(text)

fill('#inputEmail','benchmark@example.invalid')
